snippet.title: Sonic Incursion Trailer 1 [HD]
snippet.description:
First trailer for my fangame, Sonic Incursion. Want a taste of what Incursion will be like? Download the first demo here - http://www.mediafire.com/download/meangeqqw6kdeo5/Sonic+Incursion+Demo+2014.rar 

Uses the SGDK extension of UDK, made by Xaklse and Epic Games respectively. 

Music used is Kele Okereke - Tenderoni.

For more information about Sonic GDK, visit the Indie DB page at http://www.indiedb.com/games/sonicgdk
